notes: Publisher TOC is the article list. Non-research items are kept and flagged is_research=0.

Author names come from the TOC when present, else from OpenAlex names recorded in the collector registry (name only; no person_id), else from a journal-side OpenAlex work harvest by DOI (names only; no person_id), else from Crossref by DOI (authors_source=crossref), else, for Quantitative Economics items with no publisher DOI, from the official Econometric Society article page (authors_source=toc_official_qe).
AER Insights begins in 2019, so 2012–2018 have 48 journals.
Internal person_ids, conflicts, and QS handoffs are excluded.
